featured_reviews.name: Ankit Lanjewar
featured_reviews.review_text:
A Heavenly Experience at Ice Cream Garden, Vasai

I recently visited Ice Cream Garden in Vasai, and I must say, it was one of the best ice cream experiences I’ve ever had! The flavors they offer are truly exceptional. I’ve never had such delicious, natural ice creams before. The range of flavors is beyond what I ever imagined possible!

During my visit around Sankranti, they had a special Til Gud flavor, which was absolutely amazing, and also a Modak flavor that captured the festive essence perfectly. Apart from these, I also tried some of their regular flavors like Cheeku, Lotus Biscoff, Hazelnut, Guava, and many more – each one was better than the last.

It’s not just the flavors that impressed me, but also the overall quality of the ice creams. They use natural ingredients, and you can taste the difference. If you’re someone who appreciates good ice cream, this is the place to visit. Highly recommended!

featured_reviews.name: Harshil Singh
featured_reviews.review_text:
I often visit Domino’s Pizza in Naigaon East, and overall it’s a solid place if you’re craving good pizza nearby. The taste is consistent with what you expect from Domino’s — fresh base, good amount of toppings, and properly baked pizzas. Garlic bread and sides are usually served hot, and the quality has been reliable most of the time.
The staff manages orders fairly well, even during rush hours, and the waiting time is reasonable. Delivery and takeaway service are also quite efficient.
However, the dine-in area could pay a bit more attention to cleanliness and overall maintenance. It’s not bad, but there’s definitely room for improvement to match the food quality and brand standards.
Overall, good food and dependable service, but a little more focus on cleanliness would easily make it a 5-star experience. For now, a fair 4 stars.
